decisions: Treat duplicate ticket_id rows as one ticket; keep the helpdesk copy.
Divide legacy_fd refund_amount_inr by 100 (Freshdesk paise). 125 dual-source refunds are exactly ×100.
Do not rank agents by rupees without the team. Returns Desk is supposed to refund.
Wrong-item / wrong-colour mapped to LOST-TRANSIT — no official code exists.
Double-fulfillment leak = refund posted + (unit cost + Rs 340 shipping).

reconciliation.note: Arjun's crore is the raw export: Freshdesk paise plus 638 re-imported tickets. After both fixes the 18-month total is Rs 67.1 lakh — about Rs 11.2 lakh a quarter, which matches Sameer's helpdesk report.

goal.statement: Cut same-order refund-plus-replacement from Rs 1.84 lakh a quarter to under Rs 0.30 lakh, worth about Rs 1.5 lakh a quarter (Rs 6.1 lakh a year).
goal.arithmetic: 2026 H1: 75 double-filled tickets, Rs 240,101 refunded plus Rs 128,140 in replacement cost (unit cost + Rs 340) = Rs 368,241 / 2 = Rs 184,120 a quarter. Target ≤ Rs 30,000 residual.
goal.why_this_not_agent_league: Refund rate has sat at 18–22% for 18 months. Rupees went up because ticket volume went up. Returns Desk refunds ~50% of its tickets — that is the job. The money you can actually stop is paying twice on the same order.

dev_sample.note: Rules were written while reading this sample. Treat as development, not proof.

evaluation.method: Two samples, both labeled from customer message + closing note against policy §5. Dropdown ignored when the text named a different event. Development n=69 (used to write rules): 96% classifier vs 55% dropdown. Held-out n=32 (frozen rules): 84% classifier vs 72% dropdown. Wrong-item / wrong-colour mapped to LOST-TRANSIT (no official code). Cleaning check is separate: 125 dual-source refunds are exactly ×100 paise.

cost.model: none — rule classifier, no paid API
cost.arithmetic: 0 × 650 tickets × 4.3 weeks = Rs 0. Pipeline is local regex over two text fields.
